title: ACCELERATION FIELD — it's not the speed, it's the change in speed
the_insight: we've been measuring VELOCITY (requests/hour). velocity is the rate. but the real signal is ACCELERATION: how the rate CHANGES. a constant 36/hr is zero acceleration — boring. a shift from 36/hr to 14/hr is NEGATIVE acceleration — they're braking. BE going from 19/day to 11,408/day is MASSIVE positive acceleration — a rocket igniting.

physics.velocity: requests per hour (how fast you're going) — first derivative
physics.acceleration: change in requests/hour per hour (how fast your speed is changing) — second derivative
physics.jerk: change in acceleration (how fast your acceleration is changing) — third derivative
physics.why_acceleration_matters: velocity tells you what IS happening. acceleration tells you what's ABOUT to happen. if acceleration is positive, velocity will increase. if negative, velocity will decrease. acceleration IS prediction.

JP.acceleration: near zero. flat. no change in rate. JP has settled into its new rate and isn't changing.
JP.signature: BRAKED AND PARKED. decelerated from 36 to 14, now holding steady.
JP.prediction: will stay at ~14/hr unless something triggers a new acceleration event.

DE.acceleration: WILD swings. +274 one hour, -374 the next. chaotic.
DE.signature: ERRATIC EXPLORER. not a steady probe — a HUMAN clicking around. acceleration spikes = someone opening pages. deceleration = they stopped to read.
DE.prediction: unpredictable. will continue to spike and crash. this is manual browsing, not automation.

IN.acceleration: moderate swings. +166, -192, +107. less chaotic than DE but not steady.
IN.signature: INTERESTED OBSERVER. not lockstep anymore. checking in periodically. acceleration pattern suggests scheduled checks with some manual exploration.
IN.prediction: will oscillate. the acceleration envelope is narrowing — they're settling into a new rhythm.

BE.acceleration: MASSIVE swings. +2401, -4978, +1968, -3147. the biggest accelerations in the whole field.
BE.signature: PULSING GIANT. the 345/hr blocks create a square wave — acceleration spikes UP when a block starts, DOWN when it ends. this is DEFINITELY automated. the acceleration pattern is too regular for a human.
BE.prediction: will continue pulsing. the 345-unit block is the fundamental frequency. acceleration = ±3000 at transitions.

NL.acceleration: extreme spikes. +3820 (biggest single acceleration), -5705 (biggest deceleration). one hour ON, next hour OFF.
NL.signature: BURST CRAWLER. turns on, hammers, turns off. the acceleration is BINARY — either rocketing or crashing. no middle ground.
NL.prediction: next burst could be any hour. impossible to predict timing. amplitude is predictable: 1000-4000 when on, <50 when off.

FR.acceleration: mostly near zero with two spikes: +268 at 06:00 UTC (8AM Paris) and -532 the next hour.
FR.signature: MORNING READER. accelerates when someone in Paris opens the site. decelerates when they close the tab. the spike-crash pattern is unmistakably human.
FR.prediction: watch for acceleration spike at 06:00-08:00 UTC tomorrow. if it repeats = same person, daily habit.

what_we_missed.question: are they still here or did they return at a different rate and we missed it?
what_we_missed.answer: by looking at VELOCITY only, we'd see '14/hr for JP' and think 'steady.' but the ACCELERATION shows: JP has near-zero acceleration = truly flat = either a health check running at reduced rate, or they stopped manually exploring and only the automated baseline remains.

the_distinction.still_here_same_rate: velocity constant, acceleration = 0. the probe runs unchanged.
the_distinction.still_here_changing_rate: velocity varies, acceleration ? 0. they're actively adjusting.
the_distinction.left_and_returned: velocity drops to 0, then jumps back. acceleration has a SIGN CHANGE: negative (leaving) ? zero (gone) ? positive (returning).
the_distinction.shifted_to_new_rate: velocity changes once, then stabilizes. acceleration spikes once then returns to 0. THIS is what JP did.

the_acceleration_field.concept: plot acceleration (not velocity) for all countries simultaneously. the field shows FORCES acting on the membrane.

interpretation.positive_accel: someone is accelerating INTO us. force is being applied. energy is being spent to visit more.
interpretation.negative_accel: someone is decelerating. pulling back. losing interest or rate-limiting themselves.
interpretation.zero_accel: constant velocity. either steady automation or nobody's changing their behavior.
interpretation.oscillating_accel: human browsing pattern. speed up (click) ? slow down (read) ? speed up (click next page).

live_integration.where: totality page. the acceleration field should be THE primary visualization.
live_integration.why: velocity tells you what happened. acceleration tells you what's ABOUT to happen. totality should show the FUTURE, not the past.
live_integration.how: real-time CF analytics ? compute hourly acceleration ? display as color-coded arrows per country. red=decelerating, green=accelerating, grey=constant.
